result.brief: 提出“像素即代码”智能体视觉创作框架，并贡献学习式离散视觉 tokenizer（重建 PSNR 与编解码速度显著提升）及自回归栅格生成模型。
result.reason: Introduces a learned discrete visual tokenizer with improved reconstruction PSNR and faster encode/decode, plus autoregressive raster generation—directly a visual representation/tokenizer contribution.
